title: Porch & Fireplace Ideas | June 2026 GenStone Project Highlights
description: Discover real June 2026 GenStone customer projects featuring porch upgrades, fireplace transformations, and DIY stone ideas to inspire your next home improvement project.
text: GenStone Project Highlights – June 2026 Porch & Fireplace Projects Amanda Lombard Director June is one of the busiest months for home improvement projects, and this month's customer submissions showcase why. Homeowners continued to enhance their outdoor living spaces while also transforming interior gathering areas with GenStone. From inviting front porches to dramatic fireplace renovations, these projects demonstrate how realistic stone finishes can completely change the look and feel of a home. It looks like real stone, was much easier to install than we anticipated, and has completely transformed the space.” FAQs Ask Away. We've Heard it All. Can GenStone be installed indoors and outdoors? Yes. GenStone panels are designed for both interior and exterior applications. They are commonly used for accent walls, fireplace surrounds, entryways, garages, outdoor kitchens, and exterior facades. Evan Trevenna Senior Project Coordinator How long does a typical GenStone project take? Most GenStone projects can be completed in a single afternoon or weekend depending on the size of the space. Because the panels are lightweight and designed to interlock, homeowners can install them much faster than traditional masonry stone. Courtney Mintz Project Coordinator Do I need special tools to install GenStone panels? No special masonry tools are required. Most projects can be completed using common tools like a circular saw, screws, a drill, and a level. The panels are easy to cut and install using standard woodworking tools. Kevin O'Dwyer General Manager Can I install GenStone panels myself? Yes. GenStone panels are specifically designed for DIY installation. Many homeowners complete projects like accent walls, fireplaces, and garage facades without hiring a contractor.
